newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $840 mln for Tuesday, May 13.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $840 mln for Tuesday, May 13.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Tuesday, May 13 are expected to total $840 million in 40 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $385 million in eight sales, with a $198 million Ocean County Utility Authority, N.J. deal through Dillion, Reed & Co., Inc. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 32 sales totaling $455 million are on the schedule. A $139 million Cleveland City School District, Ohio, deal at 1100 EDT is the largest.
An additional five sales totaling $258 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Tuesday depending on market conditions.
